snippet.title: ARCANES | TRAILER DEMO
snippet.description:
You don't choose who you become in Luffendor — you earn it.

A Metroidvania focused on exploration, ancient secrets, and a forest that remembers everything.

Fight for a place among its people. Explore a world shaped by a forgotten catastrophe. And uncover why the forest pulled a nameless boy from an ancient oak — and called him kin.

Follow us on https://www.instagram.com/livingbots_/
